test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Pointing to a girl, a man says, "She is the only daughter of the only child of my mother." How is the man related to the girl?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Given: The man says, "She is the only daughter of the only child of my mother."

Only child of my mother = the man himself (since he is the only child)

Only daughter of the only child of my mother = the man’s daughter

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ffb924c88cfff5ba216b4925bc55daaa5a52a16c459611562a11d3a6b33df261.png] 

So, the girl is the man’s daughter.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
